goalOutcome:
Build "Community Project Hub v0.1": local full-stack Node.js web app: REST API, SQLite persistence, vanilla HTML/CSS/JS frontend, tests, README.

Stack: Node.js built-ins only (node:http, node:sqlite, node:test, node:assert). No npm deps. No build step. Server serves /api/* JSON + static frontend from public/. Write ALL files, then finish.

9 files:
1. server.js — node:http + node:sqlite. Tables projects(id,name,description,status,created_at) + tasks(id,project_id FK→projects ON DELETE CASCADE,title,description,status,created_at). REST: GET/POST /api/projects, GET /api/projects/:id, GET/POST /api/projects/:id/tasks, PATCH /api/tasks/:id, GET /api/tasks?status=todo|in-progress|done. Validation: reject empty name/title, invalid status. Codes 200/201/400/404/500. JSON {ok,data,error}. DB=process.env.DB_FILE||"hub.db". Port=process.env.PORT||3000.
2. public/index.html — dashboard: project list, create-project form, status filter, project detail + task list + create-task form, task status dropdown.
3. public/styles.css — responsive mobile-first, max-width 960px.
4. public/app.js — fetch projects, create, view tasks, create task, PATCH status, filter, feedback.
5. test/api.test.js — node:test, real HTTP requests covering every endpoint + validation + 404s.
6. test/db.test.js — node:test, verify tables, FK, cascade delete, persistence.
7. test/integration.test.js — node:test, full lifecycle: start, create project+task, update status, kill, restart, verify persisted.
8. package.json — name "community-project-hub", type commonjs, scripts.start="node server.js", scripts.test="node --test test/api.test.js test/db.test.js test/integration.test.js".
9. README.md — install, startup, test, API table, browser usage.

Full per-file spec in context. After ALL 9 files, call: {"action":"finish","summary":"Done","artifacts":["server.js","public/index.html","public/styles.css","public/app.js","test/api.test.js","test/db.test.js","test/integration.test.js","package.json","README.md"]}
